output.count_other_span: Methods: Among Atherosclerosis Risk in Communities study participants with available proteomics (Somascan v4) at study Visit 5 (2011-13; n=4,899; age 76 ± 5 years, 57% women), we used multivariable linear regression to evaluate the association of 4,877 plasma proteins with peak aortic valve (AV) velocity and AV dimensionless index.
